goal_scoring_method: Task-level phrase and lexical overlap (Core tasks weighted 1.0, Supplemental 0.7; available O*NET IM/RT rating weights). Linked DWA phrases count less than direct Task phrases. Top-three task aggregation uses fixed saturating scale 0–100. Rankings are exploratory and NOT probabilities or UN certifications.
